name: Ex World Online
summary:
Ex world Online is a Free to play anime inspired small scale MMORPG developed by Z house Studios. The features and mechanics in Ex World are heavily inspired by social and combat mechanics from a plethora of favorite anime we enjoy, this will give players the feeling of a fast-paced hybrid combat game that will give players a true mastery over their respective class choice. The approach we are taking with Ex world is an old school class and character progression type while maintaining a healthy balance between old school & modern gameplay mechanics.

Ex World will feature three races at the start of the game. Humans, Vampires, and Werewolves. It’s important to note that while there are selectable races, Ex world is not faction based. Each race has multiple common classes shared across the spectrum, while maintaining their own class identity.
